A couple of notes about the DST overlap this week (so we're explicit): the US spring forward overnight means PDT/EDT shifts on Sun morning — EU does its clock change a week later, so the hour mapping will be different for a few days. Practically that means your Option B at 5:00 PM PDT will be late for our Berlin engineers (they'd be around 01:00 CET if the EU hasn't shifted yet).

Proposals (quick, shortlist):
- Proposal 1 (exec-friendly): 11:00 AM EDT / 08:00 AM PDT on Tue — our EU engineers can join at 19:00 CET (a late but acceptable hour for senior engineers). We can push to 18:30 CET if you need a slightly earlier EU slot.
- Proposal 2 (follow-up + recording): 5:00 PM PDT exec demo (your Option B) as a recorded exec walkthrough; follow up same-week with a live technical Q&A at a mutually convenient overlapping hour (we could host the Q&A mid-morning CET / early morning PDT).

Operational ask: can you confirm which you prefer; if Proposal 2, we'll send a short recording + schedule the follow-up Q&A invite. If Proposal 1, I'll lock a calendar invite and request a rotating host from our EU infra team so we don't burn late-night on-call.

I've attached a provisional calendar invite (.ics) with the two suggested slots.
